newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia says awaiting Bank of China application.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia says awaiting Bank of China application.

text.p: The Bank of China, which wants to set up a branch in Malaysia, has yet to submit an application for the branch licence, a newspaper quoted Deputy Finance Minister Wong See Wah as saying.

Wong told Parliament on Wednesday that the government has decided to allow foreign, state-run banks like Bank of China to set up subsidiaries in Malaysia to promote bilateral economic ties, the daily Business Times reported on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted him as saying that if a formal application were received, Bank of China would be able to open an office in Malaysia by the middle of next year.
Bank of China had made the request earlier this year, citing the growing trade between China and Malaysia. Later, the State Bank of India also put forward a request for a branch office.

Malaysia has stopped issuing licences to set up new banks and is trying to promote mergers among existing ones to create strong, large organisations before opening up the market according to World Trade Organisation requirements.
